Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori Anime Overview:

Yuri Suzuki is a normal high school student living in twentieth-century Japan until a supernatural force pulls her through time and space into the ancient Middle East. She abruptly finds herself in the middle of the fourteenth-century BCE Hittite Empire, a powerful Bronze Age civilization currently engaged in intense geopolitical conflicts. Targeted by the ambitious and ruthless Queen Nakia, who requires a foreign sacrifice for a dark ritual, Yuri is rescued by Prince Kail Mollis, the third heir to the throne. To stay alive in a court full of political assassination plots and imperial warfare, Yuri must navigate unfamiliar customs and fierce rivalries. Alongside the prince, she learns to adapt to the dangers of the ancient world while searching for a way to return to her own time, all while the royal family and military commanders become entangled in the escalating struggle for succession.
